phase: Source-LODO error-trained bounded reliability gate v1
target: clip((branch-parent)*(y-parent)/((branch-parent)^2+0.01^2),0,0.75); domain/cell-equal weighting times disagreement squared+0.01^2, mean-normalized
fit: Weighted Ridge on budgeted source-LODO B and B1 errors; B gate applies B/B2 and B1 gate applies B1/B12. No pseudo-OOF M2 training examples.
selection: B12 original validation domain-equal MAE selects shared view/alpha/gain. No target query labels for fitting or inference.
controls: Same branch/gain with source-weighted constant gate per parent family
limits: B/B1-to-post-M2 gate transfer is a hypothesis
Reliability score is not calibrated probability
Frozen originals and CALCE exclusion preserved
